extras.trigger: support tactical role near an injured non-support ally

extras.notes: No hostile damage. Must disappear immediately on interrupt, death, residency loss or invalid ally; do not imply successful healing until HP changes.

runtime_mapping_defects.evidence: v1 source brief P_blade explicitly lists shadow_blink; projectile_art.LEGACY does not translate delayed_shadow/thorn.
trail spawns pool with thorn skin but no GROUND_ART.LEGACY wax_lancer entry exists.

exclusions.reason: Despite the internal name, it is a directly placed CH03 E08 enemy; no summon skill is implemented.
Body contact damage is not a timed skill with a windup and does not need a fake telegraph.
Boss art is outside the ordinary-enemy audit.
